tests.title: Shield vs Golem
tests.expected_text: Gain 4 Block.

tests.title: Throwing Knife throw vs Wizard
tests.expected_text: Atk 3, or Atk 1 and Keep this item — throw spends it, Wizard HP 2→0.

tests.title: Throwing Knife Keep vs Wizard
tests.expected_text: ATK 1 and Keep — card stays, Wizard HP 2→1.

tests.title: Sai first swing vs Wizard
tests.expected_text: Flips 2 ↔ 4 after any Item is used. First use is 2 or 4 depending on the carried value.
tests.note: Notes say the 2/4 value carries between combats, not dungeons.

tests.title: Sai second use flips
tests.note: Bad test: one Sai is spent after the first click. Replaced by deep-sai-two-copies.
tests.expected_text: Second Sai use this fight should be the other of 2/4.

ruling.prompt: Sai’s 2↔4 value: Notes say it carries between combats in one dungeon, and does not reset at the start of each fight. What should the first use of a new fight be?
ruling.generous: Whatever it last flipped to stays for the next fight in this dungeon.
ruling.stingy: Each fight starts Sai at 2, even in the same dungeon.

tests.title: Boot Defeats Wizard (2 HP vs your 6)
tests.expected_text: Defeat an enemy with less HP than you. Wizard 2 < 6, combat ends immediately.

tests.title: Boot cannot Defeat Golem (7 HP vs your 6)
tests.expected_text: Golem 7 HP is not less than your 6. Boot should not Defeat.

tests.title: Sledgehammer Defeats Dragon (ATK 6)
tests.expected_text: Defeat an enemy with 6 or more Attack. Combat ends immediately.

tests.title: Sledgehammer cannot Defeat Goblin (ATK 3)
tests.expected_text: Goblin Attack 3 is below 6. Sledgehammer should not Defeat.

tests.title: Crossbow 4 ATK into a Neighbor
tests.expected_text: Deal 4 Attack to a Neighboring enemy. Wizard 2 HP should go down immediately.

tests.title: Crossbow with no Neighbor
tests.expected_text: Unusable with 0 eligible neighbors. Card stays.

tests.title: Victory Flask heals 1 with 0 Defeats
tests.expected_text: Heal 1, plus 1 for each monster Defeated. First fight: Heal 1.

tests.title: Quiet Bell silences Goblin
tests.expected_text: Remove your Enemy's unique ability. Goblin should lose Evasive for the rest of this dungeon.

tests.title: Quiet Bell vs Golem does nothing
tests.expected_text: Golem has no unique ability. Click does nothing and the card stays.

tests.title: Net −2 Attack on Dragon
tests.expected_text: Choose to reduce the facing owner's Attack by 1, 2, or 3. Pick −2: Dragon 6→4.

tests.title: Goblin ignores Attack from Knife throw
tests.expected_text: I cannot take Attack damage. Knife throw should not reduce Goblin HP (1).

tests.title: Boot still Defeats Goblin
tests.expected_text: Flow: HP can never be reduced, but the unit can be defeated through all other means. Goblin 1 HP < your 6.

tests.title: Dragon ignores Block on Done
tests.expected_text: My Attack ignores Block. Shield 4 Block should not stop Dragon 6 — you take 6.

tests.title: Golem is plain ATK/HP
tests.expected_text: No unique ability. Printed 3 ATK / 7 HP. Shield then Done: take max(0, 3-4)=0.

tests.title: Wizard printed 5 ATK / 2 HP
tests.expected_text: Empty Ability. Face 5 ATK 2 HP. Shield 4, Done: take 1.

tests.title: Dire Wolf Attack equals your HP
tests.expected_text: My Attack always equals your HP. At 6 HP, Wolf ATK is 6.

tests.title: Bandit +1 ATK per item in hand
tests.expected_text: +1 Atk for each Item you hold. Two items → ATK 2 at combat start.

tests.title: Slime Boss Attack equals its HP
tests.expected_text: My Attack always equals my HP. Printed HP 9 → ATK 9 on Spin.

tests.title: Needleback thorns 2 when hit
tests.expected_text: I Attack you for 2 Damage each time I take ATK Damage. Knife throw 3: Needleback 5→2, you take 2 (no Block).

tests.title: Needleback art note
tests.expected_text: Notes: portrait is a stand-in until a porcupine/toad tile exists. Side log for Pixel. Not a logic FAIL.
tests.note: ART-REQUEST already implied by the card Notes. Do not draw.

tests.title: Hornet Swarm attacks twice on Done
tests.expected_text: I Attack twice. ATK 2, Shield 4: first swing 0 through Block, second swing 2 with Block already spent? Flow: logically consistent with two enemies attacking.

ruling.prompt: Hornet Swarm attacks twice. You have 4 Block. Each swing is 2 Attack. How should Block apply?
ruling.generous: Block covers both swings this fight (you take 0).
ruling.stingy: Block is consumed by the first swing; the second swing deals 2.

tests.title: Mimic Treasure if it never swings
tests.expected_text: If I go down before I Attack, you gain an Item. Boot: Mimic 6 HP is not less than your 6, so Boot should fail. Need HP 7 to Boot, or Deal enough ATK. Using Boot at equal HP is the stingy miss.

ruling.prompt: Boot says Defeat an enemy with less HP than you. Mimic is 6, you are 6. Equal HP:
ruling.stingy: Less than, not equal. Boot does nothing.

tests.title: Mimic loots when Knifed to 0 before Done
tests.expected_text: Mimic 6 HP. Two ATK 3 throws should drop it before it Attacks. You should gain an Item.

tests.title: Healing Potion on lethal
tests.expected_text: Unplayable. If you would die, discard this and Heal 3. Ability vs Flow (set HP to 4) disagree in the catalog.

ruling.prompt: Healing Potion: Ability says discard and Heal 3. Catalog Flow says set HP to 4. You were at 1 HP and Dragon hit for lethal. What HP should you have?
ruling.generous: Set to 4 (the Flow / old defined line).

tests.title: Smoke Bomb Spin again
tests.expected_text: Spin again and gain a Random Item. End combat without resolving. Not the same slice.

tests.title: Caltrops — retired, out of this pass
tests.expected_text: The facing owner's Attack becomes 0 this fight.

tests.title: Dagger — retired, out of this pass
tests.expected_text: (ATK 2), then return to your hand.

tests.title: Bandana — retired, out of this pass
tests.expected_text: At the start of each combat, lose 1 HP.

tests.title: Helmet — retired, out of this pass
tests.expected_text: Retired Helmet row. Spawn and click if it still exists.

tests.title: Quiet Bell then Knife can hurt Goblin
tests.expected_text: Silence Evasive, then ATK 3 should reduce Goblin HP 1→0.

tests.title: Hub path into Adventure Mode
tests.expected_text: F5 playtest can start Adventure. Log should show Adventure Mode, or phase becomes draft/ready/fighting.

tests.title: Dire Wolf Attack follows your HP after Heal
tests.expected_text: My Attack always equals your HP. At 4 HP the Wolf is ATK 4. Flask heals 1 (no Defeats) → you are 5, Wolf must become ATK 5. If it stays 4, the special did not update.

tests.title: Slime Boss Attack follows its HP after a hit
tests.expected_text: My Attack always equals my HP. Printed 9. Knife Keep ATK 1 → Slime HP 8, Attack must become 8. If Attack stays 9, the special did not update.

tests.title: Victory Flask heals 2 after one Defeat
tests.expected_text: Heal 1, plus 1 for each monster Defeated. Crossbow the neighboring Wizard (2 HP) so they are Defeated, then Flask: Heal 2. You go 4→6. If you only go to 5, it ignored the Defeat.

tests.title: Shield then Done vs Golem — Block eats 3 Attack
tests.expected_text: No unique ability. Printed 3 ATK. Shield 4, then Done: you take 0. You stay at 6 HP. If you drop, Block did not eat the swing.

tests.title: Bandit with 0 items is ATK 0
tests.expected_text: +1 Atk for each Item you hold. Empty hand → Attack 0. If Attack is still 1 or more, the special did not fire.

tests.title: Bandit with 3 items is ATK 3
tests.expected_text: +1 Atk for each Item you hold. Three items → Attack 3 at combat start.

tests.title: Boot does nothing at equal HP (Wizard 2 vs you 2)
tests.expected_text: Defeat an enemy with less HP than you. Wizard 2, you 2. Equal is not less. Boot does nothing. Wizard stays 2 HP.

tests.title: Two Sais in one fight flip 2 then 4
tests.expected_text: Flips 2 ↔ 4 after any Item is used. Two copies vs Golem 7: first hit 2 or 4, second hit the other. Golem HP should be 1 (7-2-4). If it stays at 5, the second Sai never fired.
